entry.name: Alcremie Gigantamax
entry.flavorEs: La nata que le brota de las manos es más dulce y sustanciosa cuando está feliz.
entry.flavorZh: 当它感到幸福的时候， 手中产生出的鲜奶油 会变得更加香浓甜美。

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep; those already asleep do not wake up.
abilities.textEs: No cae dormido y evita también que sus aliados se duerman.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep, but those already asleep do not wake up immediately. This Pokemon and its allies cannot use Rest successfully or become affected by Yawn, and those previously affected will not fall asleep.
abilities.detailEs: Evita que los Pokémon aliados se duerman.
abilities.detailZh: 防止我方宝可梦陷入睡眠状态。

abilities.textEn: Protects user/allies from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.
abilities.textEs: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados de ataques que impiden elegir movimientos.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon and its allies cannot become affected by Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, or Torment.
abilities.detailEs: Protege a los aliados contra los movimientos que afectan a su estado mental.
abilities.detailZh: 保护我方宝可梦不受影响精神状态的招式的影响。
abilities.detailPt: Protege os aliados contra movimentos que afetam seu estado mental.
